_comment: Where Vasudha downloads its weights on first run.
Edit this file and restart — no rebuild needed. A copy beside Vasudha.exe,
or at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Vasudha\model_source.json, overrides the bundled one.
NOT a GitHub release: assets are capped at 2.00 GiB and every quant of this
model is larger (Q3_K_M is 2.11 GiB). HuggingFace has no cap, serves over a
CDN, and supports range requests, which is what makes resuming work.
Publish the sha256 too. A truncated 2.2 GB GGUF does not fail cleanly at
load time; verifying turns a confusing tensor error into one clear message.
